duplication.why: No logic is copied; the sign-dependent branch is simplified to a single subtraction and Math.min.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All server paths (forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, preview, schedule-template, API) already call getExpectedAmount/getScheduledAmount.
